name: apple-messages-mcp-remote
description: MCP server for interacting with Apple Messages on macOS, with an optional remote HTTP transport for always-on Macs. Fork of @griches/apple-messages-mcp.

scripts.test: npm run build && bun test tests/applescript.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings --test tests/database.test.ts tests/http-transport.test.ts
scripts.test:clean: npm run build && bun test --bail tests/applescript.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings --test tests/database.test.ts tests/http-transport.test.ts
